correctness.rationale: In any sequential Rule90 permutation sweep, the updated-neighbor dependence satisfies (I−L)y=Ux over F2 with L strictly lower triangular in time order. The determinant expansion of z(I−L)−U permits exactly disjoint transpositions of cycle edges and two Hamiltonian orientations, yielding H_n(z)+z^a+z^(n−a). The matching polynomial trace recurrence is monomial z^n precisely at n powers of two; terms of degree below n/2 prevent nilpotency unless a=n/2. Eulerian ascents count cyclic update permutations. Independently constructed all 5910 sweep maps n=3..7; checked char polynomials by an unrelated permutation determinant algorithm through n=5 and nilpotence of every n<=7 schedule; n=4 has exactly 16 nilpotent orders. Exact 0011->0101->0000 under pi=(0,2,1,3) and the n=16 five-sweep adjacent-pair extinction under even-then-odd order check the contrary-literature boundary.
